r13_contract.comparisonModel: PWOM shall include risk-based procedures covering voyage-limit avoidance, environmental forecasts, information limitations, required-equipment operation, and applicable low-temperature, topside-icing, and sea-ice functionality measures.
r13_contract.verificationPolicyBasis: The category policy is based on the source requirement and intrinsic verification method. It is independent of whether any particular LLM model previously succeeded or failed to generate a SHACL shape.

test_cases.rationale: Risk-based PWOM procedure coverage contains every frozen R13 element.
PWOM risk-procedure element voyageLimitAvoidance not satisfied.
PWOM risk-procedure element environmentalForecastArrangements not satisfied.
PWOM risk-procedure element informationLimitationMeasures not satisfied.
PWOM risk-procedure element requiredEquipmentOperation not satisfied.
PWOM risk-procedure element environmentalFunctionalityMeasures not satisfied.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
